description: AERPAW at North Carolina State University publishes this experimental collection. FlyPaw records UAV and base-station network performance for route planning that adapts to communications availability. The collection includes iperf measurements, srsRAN telemetry, radio observations and mission-state information. The provider describes scheduling flight routes and data transmission according to link availability, latency and data timeliness. It supplies observations for evaluating edge/cloud interactions and communications-aware UAV mission planning. Coverage is limited to the described experimental campaign. The linked Dryad release is registered under CC0 1.0 and is publicly accessible without charge. Formats and variables are described by the provider; the files were not downloaded. Caveats include campaign-specific equipment and conditions, which limit transfer to other networks. Simulation use: Communications-aware flight-route and transmission optimisation. Related records include the NSF PAWR testbed platform, which describes the wider experimental infrastructure.
